notes.title: Aliens After Ava - Q & A & Speedrun
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who has played the game so far! Sean thought it would be fun to do a little Q & A and see who can finish first! We'll see you there, come with some questions and we'll be happy to show more behind the scenes and what we are up to!
[b][url=https://www.twitch.tv/aliensafterava]
Join the stream on our Twitch channel here[/url][/b] at 9 PM est this Thursday, February 16th, 2023!

-Alejandro

notes.title: Aliens After Ava - Behind the Scenes (Second Try!)
notes.content:
After a slightly rocky start with yesterday's attempt at live streaming, [i]now[/i] let's play as Ava, a survivor out in the wild in the midst of an alien invasion! I'll be playing the demo which previews the first level of the game, and afterwards talking about how the game was made and going behind the scenes on the code, art, and development process! I'll answer questions along the way :) see you then!

-Alejandro
